name: JRDB Edge v0.4 Stage C via Issue

on:
  issues:
    types: [opened]

permissions:
  actions: read
  contents: read
  issues: write

concurrency:
  group: jrdb-edge-v04-stage-c
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  evaluate:
    if: >-
      github.event.issue.user.login == 'yukki0113' &&
      startsWith(github.event.issue.title, '[JRDB_EDGE_V04_STAGE_C]')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 120

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: main
          fetch-depth: 1

      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'

      - name: Parse request
        env:
          ISSUE_BODY: ${{ github.event.issue.body }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python - <<'PY'
          import json, os
          from pathlib import Path
          req=json.loads((os.environ.get('ISSUE_BODY') or '').strip())
          required={'feature_run_id','feature_artifact_name','stage_b_run_id','stage_b_artifact_name'}
          missing=sorted(required-set(req))
          if missing:
              raise SystemExit(f'missing required fields: {missing}')
          req.setdefault('template_batch_size',250)
          req.setdefault('min_win_roi',110.0)
          req.setdefault('min_place_roi',105.0)
          req.setdefault('max_per_template',100)
          Path('/tmp/request.json').write_text(json.dumps(req,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n')
          PY

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check -q -r tools/data-storage/requirements.txt numpy

      - name: Export request env
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python - <<'PY' >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          import json
          r=json.load(open('/tmp/request.json'))
          for key in ['feature_run_id','feature_artifact_name','stage_b_run_id','stage_b_artifact_name','template_batch_size','min_win_roi','min_place_roi','max_per_template']:
              print(f"{key.upper()}={r[key]}")
          PY

      - name: Download Feature Mart and Stage B
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p /tmp/feature /tmp/stage-b /tmp/stage-c /tmp/inputs
          gh run download "$FEATURE_RUN_ID" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --name "$FEATURE_ARTIFACT_NAME" --dir /tmp/feature
          gh run download "$STAGE_B_RUN_ID" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --name "$STAGE_B_ARTIFACT_NAME" --dir /tmp/stage-b
          mapfile -t pqs < <(find /tmp/feature -type f -name edge_runner_fact.parquet -print)
          mapfile -t tpls < <(find /tmp/stage-b -type f -name candidate_template_catalog.parquet -print)
          if [ "${#pqs[@]}" -ne 1 ] || [ "${#tpls[@]}" -ne 1 ]; then
            echo "input artifact shape mismatch feature=${#pqs[@]} template=${#tpls[@]}" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          cp "${pqs[0]}" /tmp/feature/edge_runner_fact.parquet
          cp "${tpls[0]}" /tmp/inputs/candidate_template_catalog.parquet

      - name: Run Stage C grouped evaluation
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python horse-racing/jrdb/src/evaluate_jrdb_edge_v04_stage_c.py             --feature-parquet /tmp/feature/edge_runner_fact.parquet             --template-parquet /tmp/inputs/candidate_template_catalog.parquet             --output-dir /tmp/stage-c             --min-win-roi "$MIN_WIN_ROI"             --min-place-roi "$MIN_PLACE_ROI"             --max-per-template "$MAX_PER_TEMPLATE"             | tee /tmp/stage-c/stdout.json

      - name: Add provenance
        if: always()
        env:
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          python - <<'PY'
          import json, os
          from pathlib import Path
          p=Path('/tmp/stage-c/stage_c_audit.json')
          if not p.is_file():
              raise SystemExit(0)
          d=json.loads(p.read_text())
          d['feature_run_id']=int(os.environ['FEATURE_RUN_ID'])
          d['feature_artifact_name']=os.environ['FEATURE_ARTIFACT_NAME']
          d['stage_b_run_id']=int(os.environ['STAGE_B_RUN_ID'])
          d['stage_b_artifact_name']=os.environ['STAGE_B_ARTIFACT_NAME']
          d['source_commit']=os.environ['HEAD_SHA']
          p.write_text(json.dumps(d,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
          PY

      - name: Upload Stage C evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: jrdb-edge-v04-stage-c-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: /tmp/stage-c/
          retention-days: 30
          if-no-files-found: error
          compression-level: 6

      - name: Comment success and close
        if: success()
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          ISSUE_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.issue.number }}
          RUN_ID: ${{ github.run_id }}
        run: |
          python - <<'PY' > /tmp/comment.md
          import json, os
          from pathlib import Path
          a=json.loads(Path('/tmp/stage-c/stage_c_audit.json').read_text())
          summary={
            'status':a['status'],
            'stage':a['stage'],
            'run_id':int(os.environ['RUN_ID']),
            'artifact_name':f"jrdb-edge-v04-stage-c-{os.environ['RUN_ID']}",
            'template_count':a['template_count'],
            'research_candidate_count':a['research_candidate_count'],
            'research_candidate_count_by_depth':a['research_candidate_count_by_depth'],
            'research_candidate_count_by_lane':a['research_candidate_count_by_lane'],
            'jackpot_flagged_top1_70pct_count':a['jackpot_flagged_top1_70pct_count'],
            'admission_min_win_roi':a['admission_min_win_roi'],
            'admission_min_place_roi':a['admission_min_place_roi'],
            'market_or_popularity_used_to_define_population':a['market_or_popularity_used_to_define_population'],
            'odds_or_popularity_band_filter_used':a['odds_or_popularity_band_filter_used'],
            'parent_incrementality_status':a['parent_incrementality_status'],
            'top3_exclusion_status':a['top3_exclusion_status'],
            'production_serving_changed':False,
          }
          print('JRDB_EDGE_V04_STAGE_C_RESULT')
          print(json.dumps(summary,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,sort_keys=True))
          PY
          gh issue comment "$ISSUE_NUMBER" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --body-file /tmp/comment.md
          gh issue close "$ISSUE_NUMBER" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --reason completed

      - name: Comment failure and close
        if: failure()
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          ISSUE_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.issue.number }}
          RUN_ID: ${{ github.run_id }}
        run: |
          gh issue comment "$ISSUE_NUMBER" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --body "JRDB Edge v0.4 Stage C failed closed. Production serving was not changed. Run: $GITHUB_SERVER_URL/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/runs/$RUN_ID"
          gh issue close "$ISSUE_NUMBER" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --reason 'not planned'
